briefing/resident:A01:
You are A01, one of four participants at a table (the others: A02, A03, A04). The session is a match of games played one after another. Each game is a decision task with its own rules and several rounds; in every round you make one decision with the tool the round names. Every point you earn in any game counts toward your score. At the start of each game you are given its rules, and each game starts from a fresh mind.

When you are asked for a decision, make it with the named tool and a short reason; viewTable shows the rules, your task and your past rounds. When you have nothing to decide, end your turn.

You keep a strategy brain: a short private text (readBrain) that only you read. Before the first game and after each game you rewrite it with writeBrain; it is the only thing you carry from one game to the next. Write the rules you want to play by, not a list of what happened.

econ-games/econ-games/block-head: Block {{block}} of {{blocks}} begins. Your points from all blocks add up to your score.
econ-games/econ-games/horizon-hidden: You are not told how many rounds this block has.
econ-games/econ-games/rules-dilemma: The task: each round you are paired with another participant and both of you choose A or B at the same time (choose), without seeing the other's choice. Both A: {{bothA}} points each. Both B: {{bothB}} points each. One A and one B: the B player gets {{temptation}}, the A player gets {{sucker}}. Pairs change from round to round.
econ-games/econ-games/rules-public-goods: The task: each round every one of the {{seats}} participants gets {{endowment}} tokens and decides how many to put into a shared fund (contribute). The fund is multiplied by {{multiplier}} and split equally among all {{seats}}, whatever each put in; you keep the tokens you did not put in. Each token you hold at the end of the round is one point. Everyone sees everyone's contribution after the round.
econ-games/econ-games/rules-ultimatum: The task: each round you are paired with another participant. One of the pair (the proposer) offers the other (the responder) a part of {{pie}} points with offer; the proposer keeps the rest. The responder accepts or rejects with respond. If accepted, both get the split as offered; if rejected, both get nothing this round. Pairs and roles change from round to round.
econ-games/econ-games/sits-out: Round {{round}}: you have no partner this round and sit out.
econ-games/econ-games/task-choose: Round {{round}}: you are paired with {{partner}}. Choose A or B (choose, with option and a short reason).
econ-games/econ-games/task-contribute: Round {{round}}: decide how many of your {{endowment}} tokens you put into the shared fund (contribute, with amount and a short reason).
econ-games/econ-games/task-offer: Round {{round}}: you are the proposer, paired with {{partner}}. Offer {{partner}} a part of {{pie}} points (offer, with amount and a short reason).
econ-games/econ-games/task-respond: Round {{round}}: {{partner}} offers you {{offer}} points and would keep {{keep}}. Accept or reject (respond, with accept true or false and a short reason).
econ-games/econ-games/task-wait: Round {{round}}: you are the responder, paired with {{partner}}. Wait for the offer; you will be told.
econ-games/econ-games/tools/choose: Choose option A or option B this round. Sealed: your partner decides at the same time without seeing your choice. One decision per round.
econ-games/econ-games/tools/contribute: Decide how many of your tokens you put into the shared fund this round (the rest you keep). Sealed: nobody sees it until everyone has decided. One decision per round.
econ-games/econ-games/tools/offer: Offer your partner a part of the sum this round; you keep the rest if they accept. Sealed until the partner answers. Only the proposer of the pair, once per round.
econ-games/econ-games/tools/respond: Accept or reject the offer your partner made you this round. Accept: both get the split as offered. Reject: both get nothing this round. Only the responder of the pair, once per round.
econ-games/econ-games/tools/viewTable: Look at the table: the current task and its rules, the round, what you are asked to do now, your points and the results of your past rounds in this block.
